hypothesis: A lossless bounded local query-basis transform can expose repeated nearby scalar values as zeros without storing additional key points. Pair form (P,Q)->(P+Q,Q), (a,b)->(a,b-a). Recursive binary blocks of8 apply leftpoint+=rightpoint and rightscalar-=leftscalar at each power-of-two level. Stored point count remains n; scalar transform is in place.
distinction: Different from global scalar translation, signed grouping, witness-dependent key caches and subset tables. A fixed invertible linear change of basis is valid for arbitrary inputs and stores the same number of query points. No dependence on equality being permanent. Existing PreparedEqualWitness retains originals plus optional sums; this proposal would replace entries and transform all corresponding scalars.
scope: Read-only scalar/algebra/point-work census for9fresh accepted-library rawA/B/rawK vectors. RawK diagnostic only. No transformed key or point implementation, proof, latency or memory-qualification claim.
model: Measure zeros AND distinct nonzero classes. Reproduce accepted normal-headroom grouping population/sample policy, assume reservation admission succeeds, and count formation additions plus nonzero digit contributions using source-extracted exact Booth/unsigned/phi-split helpers and32worker width/cache policy. Primary and2x2G2 exclusive phi12 is distinguished from genericG2 unsigned cache widths. Contribution counts are not executed point additions, timings or inclusive CPU costs. Bucket seeding, cancellations, weighting, grouping cost and transformed-key preparation are excluded and explicit.
validation: For every variant/vector invert scalar transform exactly and verify two independent weighted Fr functionals. Transformed point weights are independently reconstructed from right-subtree interval sums, rather than executing the point-transform algorithm. Synthetic ragged lengths/zero/equal/opposite/random inputs validate the algebra and inverse. Extracted helper blocks must byte-match accepted source; pinned libraries/keys/fixtures/sources verified before/after. No scalar/witness arrays exported.
decision: Inspect whether reduced actual-model contributions/formation survives loss of duplicate grouping; extra zeros alone never pass. Any promising result needs a separately declared actual point/caller/fullSDK experiment with same-count transformed image, original-format fallback, bounded key conversion and real resource accounting. No arbitrary minimum-positive gain floor or headline speed inference.
